document.abstract: A 16mm motion-picture projector developed for the Air Force is used for viewing and assessing film exposed in 16mm gun cameras. Features include local and remote control of 360° rotation of projected image, focusing, framing, forward and reverse, and single-frame projection. Film speeds are variable from 12 to 32 frames/-sec.
